title: Technical assistant
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Technical assistant em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Do you have experience in the technical field – preparing technical reports, testing equipment and providing a high level of customer service? Are you self-driven and goal-oriented, with a technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?   At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Technical Assistant based in Campinas.   DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.   About The Job   The Technical Assistant will serve as a key member of the team, performing equipment testing and repairs, carrying out projects and applications of controls and instruments under technical parameters, and working under collaboration with our global colleagues.   Working Tasks and Responsibilities   Carrying out equipment testing and repair activities in accordance with DEIF's technical processes, ensuring formal process requirements are met and keeping internal record systems up to date. Managing projects and applications of controls and instruments, developing technical specifications for equipment according to customer requirements. Providing technical support and service to internal and external customers, by telephone or in person. Carrying out commissioning, installation, start-up and field technical assistance. Preparing training materials and conducting training sessions for customers, either at DEIF facilities or at our customers' sites. Specifying necessary components for repair, application or technical support of equipment for customer quotation. Providing technical support to the sales department as needed. Preparing technical documentation for the execution and sale of product applications and related projects. What You'll Bring   Technical training in electrical/ electronic fields. Higher education (University Degree) is an advantage. Experience in the technical field, preferably in power generation – electrical/electronic. Experience in preparing technical reports and handling client interactions. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace. Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.   At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.   We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.   Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at Deif. Com.

To apply, please include:   - Your resume   - A short note about your relevant experience   - Your Linked In profile, if available

title: Technical project manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical project manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the Company   Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.   About the Role   The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.   Responsibilities   Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead. Qualifications   5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, Git Hub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms. Required Skills   ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows. What Success Looks Like   Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process. Ideal Candidate   The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Cloud windows infrastructure engineer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Cloud windows infrastructure engineer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer   Job Purpose   As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, Power Shell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.   AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.   The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.   This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.   Role Responsibilities   Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation. Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services. Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA. Author and maintain Power Shell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate. Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, Cloud Watch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service. Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning. Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, Cloud Watch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards. Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards. Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation. Essential Skills & Experience   Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)   7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above. Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery. Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSo P, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering. IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning. DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience. Advanced Power Shell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity. Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments. Windows performance troubleshooting: Perf Mon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics. Identity & Authentication   Hybrid identity: AD on-prem cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS. SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting. Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments. AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)   Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, Cloud Watch. AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store. AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector. Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.   Service Operations & Remote Working   Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management. Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA. Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken. Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup. Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague. Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement   This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:   Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office. Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role. Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage. Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage. On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

title: Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.   This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.   About us   Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2 B company intelligence platform.   We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.   The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.   Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, Dev Ops and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.   The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.   This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.   Role description   As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product.   Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.   You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.   The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, Sage Maker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and Type Script.   You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.   Your work includes:   • Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection   • Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats   • Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production   • Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases   • Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value   • Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling   • Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time   • Working with AWS services such as Lambda, Sage Maker, S3 and ECS   • Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows   This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.   Requirements   You bring:   • At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience   • Strong Python skills   • Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3   • Real production experience with ML on AWS   • Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning   • Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data   • Experience with JSON, No SQL data and scraped web content   • A strong eye for correctness and data quality   • Business level English   • The ability to work independently in a small remote team   • A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership   Conditions   • 12 month B2 B contract   • Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap   • Flat structure with direct communication   • Production product with real users and real data problems   • Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence   • Compensation based on senior contractor level   The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.   Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars   Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo's needs.

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:   Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:   Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:   Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Professor de francês em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!   A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.   Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.   Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.   *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*   O que oferecemos?   Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?   Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.   Necessário:   Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial?   Aqui você é mais que um professor.   Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.   Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.   Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.   Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.   Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!   O que eu faço?   Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.   QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?   Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.   Seja diferente, seja independente

Company Description   Gravity Interactive, Inc., established in California in 2003, is a leader in the online gaming industry, providing Gravity games to gamers across North America and beyond. It is the wholly owned subsidiary of Gravity Co., Ltd., a company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Gravity Co., Ltd. is globally renowned for developing the popular MMORPG title, Ragnarok Online, which has captivated players worldwide. With a mission to deliver exceptional gaming experiences, Gravity Interactive continues to serve a diverse and international audience.   Role Description   This is a month-to-month contract role for a Portuguese and English Bilingual LQA Specialist, for the project we estimate to last approximately 6 months. The role involves conducting linguistic quality assurance (LQA) tests for gaming content, identifying and rectifying translation errors, and ensuring linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance in Portuguese and English, ensuring consistency in the use of terminology across game mechanics, in-game items, storyline elements, and related materials. This position will assess text placement within the user interface and make linguistic adjustments where necessary to accommodate language expansion or contraction. The specialist will collaborate with the QA team and other departments when relevant, offering linguistic or localization support to facilitate overall project quality.   Qualifications   Be able to translate minimum of 2000 words/day and/or to review/edit 5000 words/day Fluency in Portuguese and English, with strong command of written and verbal communication in both languages Experience in Linguistic Quality Assurance (LQA) testing or localization, with the ability to identify and address linguistic, cultural, and contextual inaccuracies Knowledge of the gaming industry, familiarity with MMORPGs, and a passion for video games Strong detail-oriented mindset, problem-solving abilities, and capacity to meet deadlines in a hybrid work environment Proficiency in translation and localization tools; basic technical aptitude is a plus Bachelor's degree in Linguistics, Translation, Localization, or a related field preferred Prior experience working in a multicultural environment is advantageous

title: Senior machine learning engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior machine learning engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.   This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.   What you'll do   Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results. What we're looking for   We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you.   You'll be successful in this role if you have:   Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow). Nice to have (not required)   Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval. Why Join Us   You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction. title: Professor de francês
description:

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!  A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.  Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.  Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*  O que oferecemos?  Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos  de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais  com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva  para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço?  Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technology Manager (Licensed Entities) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut  People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role  Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do. We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives. You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing  Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil  What you'll need  5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems Great organisational and time management skills Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks Solid analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Fluency in English  Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates:  Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels.  We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive.  Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.  If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.    O DESAFIO:  Garantir a disponibilidade, performance e escalabilidade de nossos serviços críticos, com foco em infraestrutura baseada em AWS EC2 (Windows Server e Linux). Desenvolver e implementar ferramentas e processos de automação para monitoramento, provisionamento, gestão de configuração e resolução de incidentes. Identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance e pontos únicos de falha em nossos sistemas. Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a arquitetura e infraestrutura de nossos produtos. Participar ativamente em análises pós-incidente para identificar causas raízes e implementar medidas preventivas. Definir e monitorar SLAs e SLOs para garantir a qualidade dos nossos serviços.  O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:  Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Confiabilidade de Site (SRE) ou função similar. Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com AWS EC2, incluindo: Criação, configuração e gerenciamento de instâncias EC2; Otimização de performance de instâncias EC2; Escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade de instâncias EC2. Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com Windows Server, incluindo: Administração de Windows Server; Active Directory; IIS (Internet Information Services); Powershell scripting. Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com sistemas Linux, incluindo: Administração de servidores Linux (ex: CentOS, Ubuntu); Gerenciamento de pacotes (ex: apt, yum); Shell scripting (Bash); Configuração de serviços (ex: Apache, Nginx). Experiência sólida com Jenkins, incluindo: Criação e gerenciamento de pipelines; Integração com diversas ferramentas (ex: Git, SonarQube, testes automatizados); Configuração de agentes e escalabilidade do Jenkins; Administração do Jenkins e resolução de problemas. Experiência com ferramentas de automação e gestão de configuração como: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Puppet, Chef. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e alerta como: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch. Habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.  VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:  Certificações AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer). Experiência com containers (Docker, Kubernetes). Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais. Experiência com outras ferramentas de CI/CD além de Jenkins. Experiência com Git.  O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ   ️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)    Assistência Médica

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Nova vaga disponível para AI Development Orchestrator em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Location:  Remote Type:  Full-Time Reports to:  CEO Stack:  TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:  Immediate The Company  Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role  You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do  Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.  Must-Haves  Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.  Strong Signals  Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.  Red Flags  AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.  Who This Person Is  3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate  No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.  What We Offer  A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.  To Apply or Refer  Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: FX Trader
description:
Empresa está contratando FX Trader em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)  or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)  markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Full Stack Engineer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About Freight Hero  FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role  This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like  A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.  Key Responsibilities:  Full Stack Engineering  Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.  AWS native Architecture  Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.  Systems Integration  Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools.  Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development  Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.  Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact  Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.  What We Are Looking For  8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.  Why Freight Hero  Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais. Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso? Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando: Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer)  para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia. Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance. Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade  dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL. Requisitos Técnicos:  Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL  e MongoDB . Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura. Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC)  com Terraform ou CloudFormation . Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python . Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade  (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD)  e Data Mesh . Cultura de Feedback  – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI). description:
Nova vaga disponível para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Role Overview  We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities  Business Development & Partnerships  Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)  Market & Network Development  Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape  Execution & Collaboration  Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships  Banking & Infrastructure Setup  Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement  Requirements  5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM   Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:

What is Teachable?  Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com. Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion,  Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team! Your Mission  We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Customer Success Operations Sr Analyst  to strengthen our Customer Success strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with CS, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization. Key Responsibilities:  Partner with CS and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy—including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities. Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth. Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives. Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor CS productivity, NRR, Excel/Google Sheets as needed. Translate business questions into analytical projects, delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency. Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews. Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.  Requirements:  3–4 years of experience in Customer Success Operations or Business Operations, preferably within a SaaS or technology company. Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus) Solid understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention). Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal). Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives. Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field. Advanced spoken and written English skills.  Why Join Us?   Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure. Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture. Competitive compensation and benefits package. This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil.  Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia  de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.  Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia  e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.   Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.   Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.  Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..  Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
